description: Compact run-level key performance indicators.
Area membership, boundary streams, maturity, and metrics.

User-supplied provenance note for the PR7 crossflow-specific electricity input.

Component mass-flow mapping.
Unit electricity demand.
Signed outlet-minus-inlet residual.
Product stream wet mass flow.
Product stream volume flow at modeled BioSTEAM conditions; distinct from normalized gas volume.
Annualized product volume at the modelled BioSTEAM stream conditions; not normalized Nm3.
Resolved value, source, status, and warnings.
Blocking and warning validation findings.
Frontend-ready unit and stream topology.
Stable plot metadata and availability.
Run-relative artifact references only.
Available, collected, and uncollected wet biomass with provenance.
Storage receipts, withdrawals, overflow, inventory, and age.
Scheduled, capacity-limited process throughput.
Eligible unit load, capacity, and utilization.

Peak monthly PR7 membrane area for seasonal module-cost screening.
